observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses a friendly, direct tone, demonstrating with a partner while verbally guiding through each count. She breaks down the footwork and hand holds clearly, turning around to show perspective from behind.

lesson_structure.note: Explanation of hold and starting positions
Step-by-step breakdown of walking forward and backward
Twirling under arms and ballroom hold
Full demonstration of the dance sequence with music

common_mistakes: Getting mixed up with hands and twisted round in the wrong way

steps_taught.name: Forward and backward steps
steps_taught.description: Three steps forward and turn around, then three steps backward and stop

what_works: Clear demonstration with two people showing both front and back views

quotes.text: So first of all we'll get you into the right hold for the Gay Gordons.
So we're going to start the dance now.
So that's only if you're getting mixed up with hands

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates partner hold face-on then turns around

extraction.distinctive_method: Turning around 180 degrees during instruction so learners can follow directly from behind.
